title: The task list and board update without reloading the page
description: Changing a task's status, priority or dates on the list, or dragging a card on the board, used to reload the whole page to show the result. Now only the tasks are read again, and a list or board you have already opened comes back at once.
items: The list and board look and work as before, including custom fields, filters, subtasks and the requests waiting for approval
If a list's comments, time or subtasks cannot be loaded, the page says so instead of showing them as empty
